fusions.name: Draw the Dose
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A pump-needle that deals 8 damage, draws your afflictions out of the target and adds 0.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Final Draught
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Fires a hollow needle that deals 20 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Belt Syrette
fusions.desc: Spring-loaded injectors remove up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Backflow Valve
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.
